subject: Vendor onboarding: PO requirement for ArborScale pilot
messages:
From: Claire Liu <claire.liu@arborscale.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New pilot onboarding — question about PO requirement

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at ArborScale is excited to start the 8-week pilot with Redwood. Before we kick off procurement on our side, I wanted to confirm Redwood's PO policy for pilots. The pilot estimate is ~$8,000. Our finance team typically prefers a PO for any supplier engagement, but I saw notes in the intake that smaller pilots sometimes proceed without a PO while vendor intake completes.

Can you advise: is a Purchase Order mandatory to start this pilot, or is there an invoice-only path we can use temporarily? If invoice-only is possible, what paperwork (W-9, contract addendum, security evidence) do you need up front? We can turn around documents quickly.

Attaching the SOW and W-9 for your intake team: ArborScale_SOW.pdf, ArborScale_W9.pdf.

Best,
Claire
Claire Liu
Head of Partnerships | ArborScale
claire.liu@arborscale.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Liu <claire.liu@arborscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New pilot onboarding — question about PO requirement

Hi Claire — thanks for sending the SOW and W-9. Quick answer: our standard is to require a PO for supplier invoices above $5k, but Procurement can approve a temporary invoice-only route for pilots on a case-by-case basis when we have the required intake evidence and a clear stop-gap payment term.

To evaluate an exception we'll need:
- Completed vendor intake form (link below)
- W-9 (received) and bank remit details
- Basic security checklist / evidence (SOC2 or security FAQ — can be high level for pilot)
- Point of contact for billing and a billing email

If Procurement approves, the pilot can run on invoice-only for up to 45 days with Net-30 payment terms; after that we’ll either require a PO or a contract amendment. If you prefer, we can expedite a PO from our side but that usually adds 7–10 business days.

I’ll loop in Karthik to confirm the intake status and Marissa for any approvals required on exception thresholds.

Link to intake form: https://app.redwood.com/vendor-intake/form/ArborScale-8421

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Liu <claire.liu@arborscale.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New pilot onboarding — question about PO requirement

Looping in Procurement note taker. Couple of clarifications from our side:

- Risk tier: we’ll classify ArborScale as "Tier 3 — low/standard" for now based on the materials, which makes a temporary invoice route feasible pending final review.
- Required evidence for exception: completed vendor intake, W-9, and security FAQ (SOC2 report preferred but a security FAQ is acceptable for pilots).
- Conditions: single pilot engagement only; total invoiced amount to Redwood must not exceed $10k under the exception. Any extension or expansion requires PO or contract amendment.

If Claire can upload the security FAQ and confirm bank remit details, I’ll run the exception request and target a same-week decision.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: 2027-04-12T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New pilot onboarding — question about PO requirement

Thanks — attached the security FAQ (ArborScale-Security-FAQ.pdf) and bank remit instructions. We can confirm billing to billing@arborscale.com and we are fine with Net-30 for the pilot.

Also to confirm: if the exception is approved, we request Redwood issue invoices on a bi-weekly cadence for milestone deliveries. Does that work?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Liu <claire.liu@arborscale.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: temporary invoice-only path for ArborScale pilot (conditions)

Hi all — I reviewed the intake materials (SOW, W-9, security FAQ) and Karthik's risk assessment. I’m approving a temporary invoice-only onboarding for the 8-week ArborScale pilot under the following conditions:

1) Invoice-only exception valid for this pilot engagement only, capped at $10,000 total.
2) Payment terms: Net-30 from invoice date; Redwood to pay per the billing cadence agreed (bi-weekly invoices acceptable).
3) Vendor must complete the vendor intake form and accept Redwood's standard supplier terms (link below) within 72 hours of this approval.
4) If ArborScale wishes to continue beyond the pilot or exceed $10,000 invoiced, a PO or contract amendment is required before any additional work.

Karthik: Please issue the exception ticket in the procurement tracker and set the intake to "priority" so we can get PO/contract drafted quickly if the pilot expands.

Claire: Welcome aboard — once you confirm the intake form is filled I’ll ask Finance to set up the invoicing route.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: ArborScale_SOW.pdf, ArborScale_W9.pdf, ArborScale-Security-FAQ.pdf
